name: BLEU
description: Commit messages play an important role in several software engineering tasks such as program comprehension and understanding program evolution. However, programmers neglect to write good commit messages. Hence, several Commit Message Generation (CMG) tools have been proposed.
reputation: Widely used as a standard automatic metric for text generation, especially in machine translation and related generation tasks.
notes: This is a metric rather than a benchmark dataset; scores are highly task- and dataset-dependent, and BLEU can correlate poorly with human judgment.
